Duskglass Quirk.name: Duskglass Quirk
Duskglass Quirk.description:
🌑 Your shadow sets into smoked black glass that casts its own shade, and you step from shard to shard through it.

🧬 A Fusion Quirk of Shadow Manipulation and Glass: each side at about half a single Quirk's reach, plus moves only the fusion can do.
🌱 At the start you bind a target in glass-edged shadow bands about five meters away and flick smoked glass beads that knock people back.
📈 With training: shadow ribbons that lower people to safety, smoked panes that cast shade even in sunlight, a circling halo of blade-shards you step between, light-drinking glass armor, and shattering a shard to pin the shadows of everyone near it.
⚠️ Without a standing shard your shadow reaches only about five meters and bright light thins it.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Bodily Toll, as glass splinters press under the skin of your palms.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: none close.

📈 Grants: Speed +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Mobility +10, Infiltration +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Umbral Band, Smoked Bead Toss
Duskglass Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: shadow and palm-grown glass fuse into shade-casting smoked glass. A new adult user binds or shadow-steps within five meters and grows a few thin panes, beads or shards a scene; more needs techniques. Limits: shardless shadow needs real shade; bright light thins it; hard hits on weak points shatter panes; plain windows never answer. Quirk Strain: light: bind, bead toss; moderate: rescue ribbon, pane, shard ring; heavy: armor, shadow-pinning shatter, spike bed; severe: signature relay, bracing a room, awakened uses. Fusion: Shadow Manipulation plus Glass, each half-scale (no block-wide shadow, no building-scale glass); only the fusion steps between shards' shade in sight, orbits glass as blades, wears it as light-drinking armor, shatters it to pin shadows. Type: Emitter. Law: the user clears public shards; shard-stepping into closed buildings is burglary. Look: glossy-edged shadow.
